project_type: React 18 + TypeScript single-page app (Vite 7), Supabase backend (Postgres + RLS + SQL domain functions). TanStack Query for data access, react-router-dom v7 for routing.
build_system: npm. Node v22 (v22.23.3). If node/npm are not on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". Dependencies already installed (package-lock.json committed, node_modules present).
test_framework: vitest (jsdom). Existing unit tests live in co-located __tests__ dirs testing pure helpers (e.g. src/features/dashboard/__tests__/helpers.test.ts, src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts, src/components/layout/__tests__/theme.test.ts). Test pure functions, not React components or SQL.
build_command: npm run build  (runs tsc -b && vite build)
test_command: npm test  (vitest run). Also: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint (eslint .), npm run format:check (prettier --check .)
verification_instructions: After each feature: run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build. The build MUST be green at the end. There are 6 PRE-EXISTING eslint warnings in untouched files; do NOT add new lint warnings/errors. SQL migrations CANNOT be executed in the sandbox (no live Supabase) - validate them by structural/logic review only.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/types/database.ts is GENERATED by the user via `supabase gen types` and MUST NOT be hand-edited. If a migration changes schema shape (adds a column), the user must re-run `supabase gen types` after merge. To keep the TS build green against generated types in the meantime, use the existing type-compat pattern (src/types/supabase-compat.ts NormalizeDatabase shim) and the documented boundary-cast pattern shown in src/features/crud/api.ts (cast supabase to a narrow local interface at a single boundary). Do NOT edit database.ts.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen; dependencies are already installed. Create and work on a NEW feature branch off main (e.g. feat/trail-coloring-and-course-editability). Do NOT commit on main.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (npm registry reachable) but no live Supabase instance exists in the sandbox: SQL migrations and RLS/trigger behavior CANNOT be executed/validated at runtime - review them structurally only and say so honestly. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR (the orchestrator publishes). Do NOT commit on main (protected default branch).
contribution_requirements: New migrations go under supabase/migrations/ with the next sequential prefix (latest existing is 0018_no_xp_for_already_correct.sql, so new files start at 0019). Do NOT modify or delete existing migrations. Migrations must be re-runnable: drop-if-exists / create-or-replace, matching the convention in 0011 (drops all public policies then recreates), 0012 (create or replace function + drop trigger if exists), 0017, 0018. Keep lint/format clean (prettier is configured; run format:check).
key_patterns: DashboardPage.tsx renders the trail: TrailTrack maps trail.modules -> dash__module (data-module-id) -> dash__module-node (background = m.module.color ?? var(--brand-purple)) + dash__lessons -> dash__lesson circles. There are currently NO connector lines between nodes (just flex gap in .dash__track). focusedModuleId state + scrollToModule() currently uses el.scrollIntoView({ inline: 'start' }) which snaps to the LEFT edge. Horizontal drag/wheel scroll is in useHorizontalDragScroll.ts (returns pointer/wheel handlers; it sets el.scrollLeft directly). Trail data from useCourseTrail in api.ts (selects modules incl. `color`, plus lessons). The modules.color column already exists (migration 0003) and api.ts/DashboardPage already read it. RLS write policies modules_write/lessons_write/questions_write in 0011 are FOR ALL and allow the creator (or admin via is_admin()) to write regardless of course.status - this is what must change. courses.status is enum course_status ('draft'|'published'); courses created as draft, published by updating status. saveCourseTree (src/features/courses/api.ts) does a DESTRUCTIVE delete-all-modules-then-reinsert on edit (would wipe existing modules of a published course); CreateCoursePage.tsx currently only CREATES (never passes draft.id), so there is no live edit-existing-course UI path today - the only existing edit surfaces are the admin CRUD (course title/status/visibility via src/features/crud) and saveCourseTree's dormant existing-course branch. updated_at touch trigger exists for all content tables (0012). is_admin() is the admin override used throughout 0011.
directory_structure: src/features/<feature>/ holds feature code (auth, courses, courses/create, crud, dashboard, friends, rooms, rankings, ...), each with api.ts (TanStack Query hooks) + page/component TSX, and co-located __tests__/ for pure helpers. src/components/ (ui/, layout/, brand/) shared UI. src/styles/theme.css global styles incl. the whole dash__* trail stylesheet. src/types/database.ts (generated) + supabase-compat.ts (type shim). supabase/migrations/ sequential SQL (0001..0018). src/App.tsx wires routes (/dashboard, /create, /crud, ...).
